description: Wire github_pr_checker.py verdict check into github_pr_webhook_receiver.py. On PR webhook, query verdict via write_service and post status check. MUST use write_service at 127.0.0.1:8772 for verdict lookup (no direct DB). FAIL the PR check if verdict is HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED or KNOWN_THREAT. Follows inter-daemon communication rules per spec section 5.
